1.1: Hamekanne leishto, rabbi eliezer omer, mekanne lah al pi shenayim, umashkah al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo. rabbi yehoshua omer, mekanne lah al pi shenayim umashkah al pi shenayim:
1.2: Ketzad mekanne lah. amar lah bifne shenayim, al tedabberi im ish peloni, vedibbera immo, adayin hi mutteret levetah umutteret leechol batteruma. nichnesa immo levet hasseter veshahata immo chede tuma, asura levetah vaasura leechol batteruma. veim met, choletzet velo mityabbamet:
1.3: Veellu asurot milleechol batteruma, haomeret temea ani lecha, veshebbau edim shehi temea, vehaomeret eni shota, veshebbalah eno rotze lehashekotah, veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech. ketzad ose lah, molichah levet din shebbeoto makom, umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech. rabbi yehuda omer, balah neeman aleha:
1.4: Hayu maalin otah levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, umeayyemin aleha chederech shemmeayyemin al ede nefashot. veomrim lah, bitti, harebe yayin ose, harebe sechok ose, harebe yaldut osa, harebe shechenim haraim osim. asi lishmo haggadol shennichtav bikdushsha, shello yimmache al hammayim. veomrim lefaneha devarim sheenah keday leshoman, hi vechol mishpachat bet aviha:
1.5: Im amra temea ani, shoveret ketubbatah veyotzet. veim amra tehora ani, maalin otah leshaar hammizrach sheal petach shaar nikkanor, sheshsham mashkin et hassotot, umetaharin et hayyoldot, umetaharin et hammetzoraim. vechohen ochez bivgadeha, im nikreu nikrau, im nifremu niframu, ad shehu megalle et libbah, vesoter et searah. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya libbah nae, lo haya megallehu. veim haya searah nae, lo haya sotro:
1.6: Hayta mitkassa vilvanim, mechassah bishchorim. hayu aleha chele zahav vekatlayot, nezamim vetabbaot, maavirim mimmenna kede lenavvelah. veachar kach mevi chevel mitzri vekoshro lemala middaddeha. vechol harotze lirot ba lirot, chutz meavadeha veshifchoteha, mippene shellibbah gas bahen. vechol hannashim muttarot lirotah, shenneemar (yechezkel 23) venivvasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena:
1.7: Bamidda sheadam moded, bah moddin lo. hi kishsheta et atzmah laavera, hammakom nivvelah. hi gilleta et atzmah laavera, hammakom gilla aleha. bayyarech hitchila vaavera techilla veachar kach habbeten, lefichach tilke hayyarech techilla veachar kach habbeten. ushear kol hagguf lo falet:
1.8: Shimshon halach achar enav, lefichach nikkeru felishtim et enav, shenneemar (Shoftim 16) vayyochazuhu felishtim vaynakkeru et enav. avshalom nitgaa visaro, lefichach nitla visaro. ulefi shebba al eser pilagshe aviv, lefichach nittenu vo eser lonviyyot, shenneemar (Shmuel b 18) vayyasobbu asara anashim nose kele yoav. ulefi shegganav shelosha levavot, lev aviv, velev bet din, velev yisrael, shenneemar (sham 15) vaygannev avshalom et lev anshe yisrael, lefichach nitkeu vo shelosha shevatim, shenneemar (sham 18) vayyikkach shelosha shevatim bechappo vayyitkaem belev avshalom:
1.9: Vechen leinyan hattova. miryam himtina lemoshe shaa achat, shenneemar (Shemot b) vattetatztzav achoto merachok, lefichach nitakkevu lah yisrael shiva yamim bammidbar, shenneemar (Bamidbar 12) vehaam lo nasa ad heasef miryam. yosef zacha likbor et aviv, veen beechav gadol mimmennu, shenneemar (Bereshit 50) vayyaal yosef likbor et aviv, vayyaal immo gam rechev gam parashim. mi lanu gadol miyyosef, shello nitassek bo ella moshe. moshe zacha veatzmot yosef, veen beyisrael gadol mimmennu, shenneemar (Shemot 13) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo. mi gadol mimmoshe, shello nitassek bo ella hammakom, shenneemar (Devarim led) vayyikbor oto vaggay. lo al moshe vilvad amru, ella al kol hatztzaddikim, shenneemar (yeshaya noach) vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha kevod Adonai yaasfecha:

2.1: Haya mevi et minchatah betoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah al yadeha kede leyaggeah. kol hammenachot techillatan vesofan bichli sharet, vezo techillatah bichfifa mitzrit vesofah bichli sharet. kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona, vezo enah teuna lo shemen velo levona. kol hammenachot baot min hachittin, vezo vaa min hasseorin. minchat haomer af al pi shebbaa min hasseorin hi hayta vaa geres, vezo vaa kemach. rabban gamliel omer, keshem shemmaaseha maase vehema, kach karbanah maachal behema:
2.2: Haya mevi feyali shel cheres chadasha, venoten letochah chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor. rabbi yehuda omer, reviit. keshem shemmemaet bakketav, kach memaet bammayim. nichnas lahechol ufana limino, umakom haya sham amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish, vetabbaat hayta kevua vah. ucheshehu magbihah, notel afar mittachteha venoten kede sheyyerae al hammayim, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim:
2.3: Ba lo lichtov et hammegilla, meeze makom hu chotev, (Bamidbar 5) meim lo shachav ish vegomer, veat ki satit tachat ishech vegomer. veeno chotev vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha vegomer. vechotev yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua vegomer, uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich latzbot beten velanpil yarech. veeno chotev veamra haishsha amen amen. rabbi yose omer, lo haya mafsik. rabbi yehuda omer, kol atzmo eno chotev, ella yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua vegomer uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich vegomer. veeno chotev veamra haishsha amen amen:
2.4: Eno chotev lo al halluach velo al hanneyar velo al haddiftera, ella al hammegilla, shenneemar (sham) bassefer. veeno chotev lo vekomos velo vekankantom velo vechol davar sheroshem, ella vidyo, shenneemar (sham) umacha, ketav sheyyachol lehimmachek:
2.5: Al ma hi omeret amen amen. amen al haala, amen al hashshevua. amen meish ze, amen meish acher. amen shello satiti arusa unesua veshomeret yavam uchenusa, amen shello nitmeti. veim nitmeti, yavou vi. rabbi meir omer, amen shello nitmeti, amen shello ettame:
2.6: Hakkol shavin sheeno matne immah lo al kodem shettitares velo al meachar shettitgaresh. nistera leacher venitmet veachar kach hechezirah, lo haya matne immah. ze hakkelal, kol shettibbael velo hayta asura lo, lo haya matne immah:

3.1: Haya notel et minchatah mittoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah letoch keli sharet, venotnah al yadah. vechohen meniach yado mittachteha umenifah:
3.2: Henif vehiggish, kamatz vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim. haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah. rabbi shimon omer, makriv et minchatah veachar kach haya mashkah, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) veachar yashke et haishsha et hammayim. im hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah, keshera:
3.3: Ad shello nimchaka hammegilla amra eni shota, megillatah nignezet, uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddashen. veen megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret. nimchaka hammegilla veamra temea ani, hammayim nishpachin uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddashen. nimchaka hammegilla veamra eni shota, meararim otah umashkin otah beal karchah:
3.4: Enah maspeket lishtot ad sheppaneha morikot veeneha boltot vehi mitmallet gidin, vehem omrim hotziuha hotziuha, shello tetamme haazara. im yesh lah zechut, hayta tola lah. yesh zechut tola shana achat, yesh zechut tola shete shanim, yesh zechut tola shalosh shanim. mikkan omer ben azzay, chayyav adam lelammed et bitto tora, sheim tishte, teda shehazzechut tola lah. rabbi eliezer omer, kol hamelammed et bitto tora, keillu melammedah tiflut. rabbi yehoshua omer, rotza ishsha vekav vetiflut mittisha kabbin uferishut. hu haya omer, chasid shote, verasha arum, veishsha ferusha, umakkot perushin, hare ellu mechalle olam:
3.5: Rabbi shimon omer, en zechut tola vammayim hammarim. veim atta omer, hazzechut tola vammayim hamearrim, madhe atta et hammayim bifne chol hannashim hashshotot, umotzi atta shem ra al hattehorot sheshshatu, sheomrim temeot hen ella shettalta lahen zechut. rabbi omer, hazzechut tola vammayim hamearrim, veenah yoledet veenah mashbachat, ella mitnavvena veholechet, lesof hi meta beotah mita:
3.6: Nitmet minchatah ad shello kadsha vakkeli, hare hi kechol hammenachot vetippade, veim mishshekkadsha vakkeli, hare hi kechol hammenachot vetissaref. veellu shemminchotehen nisrafot, haomeret temea ani lecha, veshebbau lah edim shehi temea, vehaomeret eni shota, veshebbalah eno rotze lehashekotah, veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech. vechol hannesuot lechohanim, minchotehen nisrafot:
3.7: Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, minchatah nisrefet. vechohenet shennisset leyisrael, minchatah neechelet. ma ben kohen lechohenet, minchat kohenet neechelet, minchat kohen enah neechelet. kohenet mitchallelet, vechohen en mitchallel. kohenet mittammea lemetim, veen kohen mittamme lemetim. kohen ochel bekadshe kadashim, veen kohenet ochelet bekadshe kadashim:
3.8: Ma ben ish leishsha. haish porea uforem, veen haishsha foraat uforemet. haish maddir et beno benazir, veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. haish megalleach al nezirut aviv, veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. haish mocher et bitto, veen haishsha mocheret et bittah. haish mekaddesh et bitto, veen haishsha mekaddeshet et bittah. haish niskal arom, veen haishsha niskelet arumma. haish nitle, veen haishsha nitlet. haish nimkar bignevato, veen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah:

4.1: Arusa veshomeret yavam, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5), asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah, perat laarusa veshomeret yavam. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, uvat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba:
4.2: Veellu lo shotot velo notlot ketubba. haomeret temea ani, veshebbau lah edim shehi temea, vehaomeret eni shota. amar balah eni mashkah, veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech, notelet ketubbatah velo shota. metu vaalehen ad shello shatu, bet shammay omrim, notlot ketubba velo shotot. uvet hillel omrim, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba:
4.3: Meubberet chavero umeneket chavero, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yachol hu lehaferishah ulehachazirah leachar zeman. aylonit uzekena vesheenah reuya leled, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba. rabbi eliezer omer, yachol hu lissa ishsha acheret velifrot velirbot hemenna. ushear kol hannashim, o shotot o lo notlot ketubba:
4.4: Eshet kohen shota umutteret levalah. eshet saris shota. al yede chol arayot mekannin, chutz min hakkatan, umimmi sheeno ish:
4.5: Veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen, mi shennitcharesh balah o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. lo lehashekotah amru, ella lefaslah mikketubbatah. rabbi yose omer, af lehashekotah, lichsheyyetze valah mibbet haasurin yashkenna:

5.1: Keshem shehammayim bodkin otah, kach hammayim bodkin oto, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) uvau, uvau. keshem sheasura labbaal, kach asura labboel, shenneemar (sham) nitmea, venitmaa, divre rabbi akiva. amar rabbi yehoshua, kach haya doresh zecharya ven hakkatztzav. rabbi omer, shene feamim haamurim bapparasha im nitmea nitmaa, echad labbaal veechad labboel:
5.2: Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva, (Vayikra 11) vechol keli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho kol asher betocho yitma, eno omer tame ella yitma, letamme acherim, limmed al kikkar sheni shemmetamme et hashshelishi. amar rabbi yehoshua, mi yegalle afar meenecha, rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shehayita omer, atid dor acher letaher kikkar shelishi, sheen lo mikra min hattora shehu tame. vahalo akiva talmidcha mevi lo mikra min hattora shehu tame, shenneemar, kol asher betocho yitma:
5.3: Bo vayyom darash rabbi akiva (Bamidbar la) umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vegomer, umikra acher omer (sham) mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv. i efshar lomar elef amma, shekkevar neemar alpayim amma, vei efshar lomar alpayim amma, shekkevar neemar elef amma. ha chetzad, elef amma migrash, vealpayim amma techum shabbat. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer, elef amma migrash, vealpayim amma sadot ucheramim:
5.4: Bo vayyom darash rabbi akiva (Shemot 15), az yashir moshe uvene yisrael et hashshira hazzot laAdonai vayyomru lemor, sheen talmud lomar lemor, uma talmud lomar lemor, melammed shehayu yisrael onin acharav shel moshe al kol davar vedavar, kekorin et hahallel, lechach neemar lemor. rabbi nechemya omer, kekorin et shema velo chekorin et hahallel:
5.5: Bo vayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hureknos, lo avad iyyov et hakkadosh baruch hu ella meahava, shenneemar (iyyov 13) hen yikteleni lo ayachel. vaadayin haddavar shakul, lo ani metzappe o eni metzappe, talmud lomar (sham 27) ad egva lo asir tummati mimmenni, melammed shemmeahava asa. amar rabbi yehoshua, mi yegalle afar meenecha, rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shehayita doresh kol yamecha shello avad iyyov et hammakom ella miyyira, shenneemar (sham 1) ish tam veyashar yere elohim vesar mera, vahalo yehoshua talmid talmidcha limmed shemmeahava asa:

6.1: Mi shekkinne leishto venistera, afillu shama meof happoreach, yotzi veyitten ketubba, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, ad sheyyisu veyittenu vah mozrot ballevana:
6.2: Amar ed echad, ani reitiha shennitmet, lo hayta shota. velo od ella afillu eved, afillu shifcha, hare ellu neemanin af lefaslah mikketubbatah. chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah, hare ellu neemanot, velo lefaslah mikketubbatah, ella shello tishte:
6.3: Shehaya vedin, uma im edut rishona sheen osartah issur olam, enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim, edut acharona sheosartah issur olam, eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim, talmud lomar veed en bah, kol edut sheyyesh bah. kal vachomer laedut harishona meatta, uma im edut acharona sheosartah issur olam, hare hi mitkayyemet beed echad, edut harishona sheen osartah issur olam, eno din shettitkayyem beed echad, talmud lomar (Devarim kad) ki matza vah ervat davar, ulehallan hu omer (sham 19), al pi shene edim yakum davar, ma lehallan al pi shenayim edim, af kan al pi shenayim edim:
6.4: Ed omer nitmet veed omer lo nitmet, ishsha omeret nitmet veishsha omeret lo nitmet, hayta shota. echad omer nitmet ushenayim omrim lo nitmet, hayta shota. shenayim omrim nitmet veechad omer lo nitmet, lo hayta shota:

7.1: Ellu neemarin bechol lashon, parashat sota, uvidduy maaser, keriat shema, utefilla, uvirkat hammazon, ushevuat haedut, ushevuat happikkadon:
7.2: Veellu neemarin bilshon hakkodesh. mikra vikkurim, vachalitza, berachot ukelalot, birkat kohanim, uvirkat kohen gadol, ufarashat hammelech, ufarashat egla arufa, umeshuach milchama beshaa shemmedabber el haam:
7.3: Mikra vikkurim ketzad, (Devarim 26) veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha, ulehallan hu omer (sham 27) veanu haleviyyim veamru, ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh:
7.4: Chalitza ketzad, (sham 25) veanta veamra, ulehallan hu omer veanu haleviyyim veamru, ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh. rabbi yehuda omer, veanta veamra kacha, ad shettomar ballashon hazze:
7.5: Berachot ukelalot ketzad. kevan sheavru yisrael et hayyarden uvau el har gerizzim veel har eval shebbeshomron shebbetzad shechem shebbeetzel elone more, shenneemar (sham 11) halo hemma beever hayyarden vegomer, ulehallan hu omer (Bereshit 12) vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem ad elon more, ma elon more haamur lehallan shechem, af elon more haamur kan shechem. shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizzim veshishsha shevatim alu lerosh har eval, vehakkohanim vehaleviyyim vehaaron omdim lematta vaemtza, hakkohanim makkifin et haaron, vehaleviyyim et hakkohanim, vechol yisrael mikkan umikkan, shenneemar (yehoshua 8) vechol yisrael uzekenav veshotrav veshoftav omdim mizze umizze laaron vegomer. hafchu fenehem kelappe har gerizzim ufatchu vabberacha, baruch haish asher lo yaase fesel umassecha, veellu vaellu onin amen. hafchu fenehem kelappe har eval ufatchu vakkelala, (Devarim 27) arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha, veellu vaellu onin amen, ad sheggomrin berachot ukelalot. veachar kach heviu et haavanim uvanu et hammizbeach vesaduhu vesid, vechatvu alav et kol divre hattora beshivim lashon, shenneemar (sham) baer hetev, venatlu et haavanim uvau velanu vimkoman:
7.6: Birkat kohanim ketzad, bammedina omrim otah shalosh berachot, uvammikdash beracha echat. bammikdash omer et hashshem kichtavo, uvammedina vechinnuyo. bammedina kohanim nosim et yedehen keneged kitfehen, uvammikdash al gabbe rashehen, chutz mikkohen gadol sheeno magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz. rabbi yehuda omer, af kohen gadol magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz, shenneemar (Vayikra 9) vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem:
7.7: Birchot kohen gadol ketzad. chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotnah lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notnah lassegan, vehassegan notnah lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol omed umekabbel vekore omed, vekore achare mot (sham 16), veach beasor (sham 23). vegolel et hattora umannichah becheko veomer, yoter mimma shekkariti lifnechem katuv kan. uveasor shebbechummash happikkudim (Bamidbar 29) kore al pe, umevarech aleha shemone verachot, al hattora, veal haavoda, veal hahodaya, veal mechilat heavon, veal hammikdash, veal yisrael, veal hakkohanim, veal shear hattefilla:
7.8: Parashat hammelech ketzad. motzae yom tov harishon shel chag, bashshemini bemotzae sheviit, osin lo vima shel etz baazara, vehu yoshev aleha, shenneemar (Devarim lo) mikketz sheva shanim bemoed vegomer. chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotnah lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notnah lassegan, vehassegan notnah lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol notnah lammelech, vehammelech omed umekabbel vekore yoshev. agrippas hammelech amad vekibbel vekara omed, veshibbechuhu chachamim. ucheshehiggia (sham 17) lelo tuchal latet alecha ish nachri, zalgu enav demaot. amru lo, al tityare agrippas, achinu atta, achinu atta, achinu atta. vekore mittechillat elle haddevarim (Devarim 1:1) ad shema, ushema (sham 6), vehaya im shamoa (sham 11), asser teasser (sham 14), ki techalle laser (sham 26), ufarashat hammelech (sham 17), uverachot ukelalot (sham 28), ad sheggomer kol happarasha. berachot shekkohen gadol mevarech otan, hammelech mevarech otan, ella shennoten shel regalim tachat mechilat heavon:

8.1: Meshuach milchama, beshaa shemmedabber el haam, bilshon hakkodesh haya medabber, shenneemar (Devarim 20) vehaya kekaravchem el hammilchama veniggash hakkohen, ze kohen meshuach milchama, vedibber el haam, bilshon hakkodesh. veamar alehem (sham) shema yisrael attem kerevim hayyom lammilchama al oyvechem, velo al achechem, lo yehuda al shimon, velo shimon al binyamin, sheim tippelu veyadam yerachamu alechem, kema shenneemar (11 28) vayyakumu haanashim asher nikkevu veshemot vayyachaziku vashshivya vechol maarummehem hilbishu min hashshalal vayyalbishum vayyanillum vayyaachilum vayyashkum vaysuchum vaynahalum bachamorim lechol koshel vayvium yerecho ir hattemarim etzel achehem vayyashuvu shomron. al oyvechem attem holchim, sheim tippelu veyadam en merachamin alechem. al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu vegomer (Devarim 20). al yerach levavchem, mippene tzoholat susim vetzichtzuach charavot. al tiru, mippene hagafat terisin veshifat hakkalgassin. al tachpezu, mikkol keranot. al taartzu, mippene kol tzevachot. ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem, hen bain benitzchono shel basar vadam, veattem baim benitzchono shel makom. pelishtim bau venitzchono shel galyat, me haya sofo, lesof nafal bacherev venaflu immo. bene ammon bau venitzchono shel shovach, me haya sofo, lesof nafal bacherev venaflu immo. veattem i attem ken. ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem lehillachem lachem vegomer, ze machane haaron:
8.2: Vedibberu hashshotrim el haam lemor mi haish asher bana vayit chadash velo chanacho yelech veyashov leveto vegomer (sham). echad habbone vet hatteven, bet habbakar, bet haetzim, bet haotzarot. echad habbone, veechad hallokeach, veechad hayyoresh, veechad shennittan lo mattana. umi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo vegomer (sham). echad hannotea hakkerem veechad hannotea chamishsha ilane maachol, vaafillu mechameshet minin. echad hannotea, veechad hammavrich, veechad hammarkiv, veechad hallokeach, veechad hayyoresh, veechad shennittan lo mattana. umi haish asher eras ishsha vegomer (sham). echad hameares et habbetula, veechad hameares et haalmana, afillu shomeret yavam, vaafillu shama shemmet achiv bammilchama, chozer uva lo. kol ellu shomin divre chohen meerche milchama vechozrin, umesappekin mayim umazon umetakkenin et hadderachim:
8.3: Veellu sheenan chozrin. habbone vet shaar, achsadra, mirpeset. hannotea arbaa ilane maachol, vachamishsha ilane serak. hammachazir et gerushato. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, lo haya chozer. rabbi yehuda omer, af habbone vayit al mechono, lo haya chozer. rabbi eliezer omer, af habbone vet levenim bashsharon, lo haya chozer:
8.4: Veellu sheen zazin mimmekoman. bana vayit vachanacho, nata kerem vechillelo, hannose et arusato, hakkones et yevimto, shenneemar (Devarim kad), naki yihye leveto shana echat. leveto, ze beto. yihye, ze karmo. vesimmach et ishto, zo ishto. asher lakach, lehavi et yevimto. enan maspikin mayim umazon veenan metakkenin et hadderachim:
8.5: (Sham 20) veyasfu hashshotrim ledabber el haam veamru mi haish hayyare verach hallevav yelech veyashov leveto. rabbi akiva omer, hayyare verach hallevav, kemashmao, sheeno yachol laamod bekishre hammilchama velirot cherev shelufa. rabbi yose haggelili omer, hayyare verach hallevav zehu hammityare min haaverot shebbeyado, lefichach talta lo hattora et kol ellu, sheyyachazor biglalan. rabbi yose omer, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, hare hu hayyare verach hallevav:
8.6: (Sham) vehaya kechallot hashshotrim ledabber el haam ufakdu sare tzevaot berosh haam, uvaakevo shel am. maamidin zekifin lifnehem, vaacherim meachorehem, vechashshilin shel barzel bidehen, vechol hamevakkesh lachazor, harshut beyado lekappeach et shokav, shettechillat nisa nefila, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 4) nas yisrael lifne felishtim vegam maggefa gedola hayta vaam, ulehallan hu omer (sham lo) vayyanusu anshe yisrael mippene felishtim vayyippelu chalalim vegomer:
8.7: Bamme devarim amurim, bemilchemet harshut. aval bemilchemet mitzva, hakkol yotzin, afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah. amar rabbi yehuda, bamme devarim amurim, bemilchemet mitzva. aval bemilchemet chova, hakkol yotzin, afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah:

9.1: Egla arufa, bilshon hakkodesh, shenneemar (Devarim 21) ki yimmatze chalal baadama vegomer veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha, shelosha mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hayu yotzin. rabbi yehuda omer chamishsha, shenneemar zekenecha, shenayim, veshoftecha, shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad:
9.2: Nimtza tamun begal, o taluy beilan, o tzaf al pene hammayim, lo hayu orfin, shenneemar (sham) baadama, velo tamun begal. nofel, velo taluy beilan. bassade, velo tzaf al pene hammayim. nimtza samuch lassefar, o leir sherubbah nachrim, o leir sheen bah bet din, lo hayu orfin. en moddin ella meir sheyyesh bah bet din. nimtza mechuvvan ben shete ayarot, shetehen meviot shete agalot, divre rabbi eliezer. veen yerushalayim mevia egla arufa:
9.3: Nimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher, molichin harosh etzel hagguf, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer, hagguf etzel harosh:
9.4: Meayin hayu moddin. rabbi eliezer omer, mittibburo. rabbi akiva omer, mechatmo. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, mimmekom shennaase chalal, mitztzavvaro:
9.5: Nifteru zikne yerushalayim vehalchu lahen. zikne otah hair meviin eglat bakar asher lo ubbad bah asher lo mashcha beol (sham), veen hammum posel bah, umoridin otah lenachal etan. veetan kemashmao, kashe. af al pi sheeno etan, kasher. veorfin otah bekofitz meachoreha. umekomah asur millizroa umillaavod, umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulenakker sham avanim:
9.6: Zikne otah hair rochatzin et yedehen bammayim bimkom arifa shel egla, veomrim, (sham) yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau. vechi al datenu alta, shezzikne vet din shofche damim hen, ella shello va leyadenu ufetarnuhu velo mazon, velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu velo levaya. vehakkohanim omrim, (sham) kapper leammecha yisrael asher padita Adonai veal titten dam naki bekerev ammecha yisrael. lo hayu tzerichim lomar (sham) venikkapper lahem haddam, ella ruach hakkodesh mevassartan, ematay shettaasu kacha, haddam mitkapper lahem:
9.7: Nimtza hahoreg ad shello neerfa haegla, tetze vetire vaeder. mishshenneerfa haegla, tikkaver bimkomah, sheal safek bata mittechillatah, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah. neerfa haegla veachar kach nimtza hahoreg, hare ze yehareg:
9.8: Ed echad omer raiti et hahoreg, veed echad omer lo raita, ishsha omeret raiti veishsha omeret lo rait, hayu orfin. ed echad omer raiti, ushenayim omrim lo raita, hayu orfin. shenayim omrim rainu veechad omer lahen lo reitem, lo hayu orfin:
9.9: Mishsherabbu haratzchanim, batla egla arufa, mishshebba eliezer ben dinay, utechina ben perisha haya nikra, chazru likroto ben haratzchan. mishsherabbu hamenaafim, pasku hammayim hammarim, verabban yochanan ben zakkay hifsikan, shenneemar (Hoshea 4) lo efkod al benotechem ki tiznena veal kallotechem ki tenaafna ki hem vegomer. mishshemmet yose ven yoezer ish tzereda veyose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim, batlu haeshkolot, shenneemar (Micha 7) en eshkol leechol bikkura ivveta nafshi:
9.10: Yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodayat hammaaser. af hu vittel et hameorrin veet hannokfin. ad yamav haya fattish makke virushalayim. uveyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay:
9.11: Mishshebbatla sanhedrin, batla hashshir mibbet hammishtaot, shenneemar (yeshaya kad) bashshir lo yishtu yayin vegomer:
9.12: Mishshemmetu neviim harishonim, batlu urim vetummim. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, batal hashshamir venofet tzufim, ufasku anshe amana, shenneemar (tehillim 12) hoshia Adonai ki gamar chasid vegomer. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, en yom sheen bo kelala, velo yarad hattal livracha, venittal taam happerot. rabbi yose omer, af nittal shomen happerot:
9.13: Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, hattohora natla et hattaam veet hareach. hammaasrot natlu et shomen haddagan. vachachamim omrim, hazzenut vehakkeshafim killu et hakkol:
9.14: Bappulmos shel aspasyanus gazru al atrot chatanim, veal haerus. bappulmos shel titus gazru al atrot kallot, veshelo yelammed adam et beno yevanit. bappulmos haacharon gazru shello tetze hakkalla baappiryon betoch hair, verabbotenu hittiru shettetze hakkalla baappiryon betoch hair:
9.15: Mishshemmet rabbi meir, batlu moshle meshalim. mishshemmet ben azzay, batlu hashshakdanim. mishshemmet ben zoma, batlu haddarshanim. mishshemmet rabbi yehoshua, paska tova min haolam. mishshemmet rabban shimon ben gamliel, ba govay verabbu tzarot. mishshemmet rabbi elazar ben azarya, pasak haosher min hachachamim. mishshemmet rabbi akiva, batal kevod hattora. mishshemmet rabbi chanina ben dosa, batlu anshe maase. mishshemmet rabbi yose katnuta, pasku chasidim. velamma nikra shemo katnuta, shehaya katnutan shel chasidim. mishshemmet rabban yochanan ben zakkay, batal ziv hachachma. mishshemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken, batal kevod hattora umeta tohora uferishut. mishshemmet rabbi yishmael ben pavi, batal ziv hakkehunna. mishshemmet rabbi, batla anava veyirat chet. rabbi finchas ben yair omer, mishshecharav bet hammikdash, boshu chaverim uvene chorin, vechafu rosham, veniddaldelu anshe maase, vegavru vaale zeroa uvaale lashon, veen doresh veen mevakkesh, veen shoel, al mi lanu lehishshaen, al avinu shebbashshamayim. rabbi eliezer haggadol omer, miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, sharu chakkimayya lemeheve chesafrayya, vesafrayya kechazzana, vechazzana keamma deara, veamma deara azla vedaldela, veen mevakkesh, al mi yesh lehishshaen, al avinu shebbashshamayim. beikkevot meshicha chutzpa yisge, veyoker yaamir, haggefen titten piryah vehayyayin beyoker, vehammalchut tehafech leminut, veen tochecha, bet vaad yihye liznut, vehaggalil yecherav, vehaggavlan yishshom, veanshe haggevul yesovvu meir leir velo yechonnanu, vechachmat sofrim tisrach, veyire chet yimmaasu, vehaemet tehe nederet. nearim pene zekenim yalbinu, zekenim yaamdu mippene ketannim. (Micha 7) ben menabbel av, bat kama veimmah, kalla bachamotah, oyve ish anshe veto. pene haddor kifne hakkelev, habben eno mitbayyesh meaviv. veal mi yesh lanu lehishshaen, al avinu shebbashshamayim. rabbi finchas ben yair omer, zerizut mevia lide nekiyyut, unekiyyut mevia lide tohora, vetohora mevia lide ferishut, uferishut mevia lide kedushsha, ukedushsha mevia lide anava, vaanava mevia lide yirat chet, veyirat chet mevia lide chasidut, vachasidut mevia lide ruach hakkodesh, veruach hakkodesh mevia lide techiyyat hammetim, utechiyyat hammetim ba al yede eliyyahu zachur lattov, amen:
